Definition: from a compound of G1722 and a derivative of the base of G1218; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says we have a building of God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens, in 2 Corinthians 5:1 — a home that waits for us when our earthly tent is taken down. This is the one place the word stands, in the reading carried by the Textus Receptus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the building God has for me is already standing, and my tent here is only temporary — I can bear its tearing down because something eternal is already built.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
